responsibility: Declares the statement class hierarchy and statement-related helper abstractions for the Go frontend, including assignment traversal callbacks, factories for concrete statement forms, and parse-stage containers for case/type-case/select clauses. This header defines the control-flow and side-effect IR used by parsing, lowering, export/import of inline bodies, AST dumping, and backend translation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the statement IR class hierarchy, statement classifications, clause containers, and assignment-traversal interfaces that parsing and lowering operate on. Unlike `statements.cc`, it defines the shape of statement nodes and helpers, not their lowering, import/export, traversal, or backend implementations.
